CHAPTER 44  Medical Nutrition Therapy for Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities
Medical Nutrition Therapy
Anthropometric Measures.  ​Height, weight, head circum-
ference, triceps skinfold, and arm circumference are ob-
tained for the child with DS with the usual measurements 
(see Chapter 7). BMI can be taken but may be higher than 
normal because of short stature. Growth measures are an
